assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Creating phased tracker issues from an implementation plan.
assessments.rationale: It triages an existing GitHub issue in a specific repository and explicitly forbids issue creation, so it does not provide the requested planning-to-issues workflow.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: One issue per delivery phase with dependencies, acceptance checks, and plan-step references.
assessments.rationale: It can create a labelled feature issue from a specification, but its single-issue constraint omits the requested phase-by-phase breakdown and dependency-aware issue content.
assessments.source_anchor: Single issue for the complete specification

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Converting an implementation plan into tracker issues.
assessments.rationale: This is an Android-to-iOS feature-porting workflow, not a route for planning or publishing implementation-plan issues.
assessments.source_anchor: # Android to iOS: Feature Parity Implementation

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: One issue per delivery phase while preserving plan order and dependencies.
assessments.rationale: It creates issues with acceptance criteria for unmet specification requirements, but its unit of work is an unimplemented requirement rather than each plan delivery phase and it does not preserve plan dependencies.
assessments.source_anchor: One issue per unimplemented requirement from specification

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Publishing classified tracker issues with references to the implementation plan.
assessments.rationale: It supplies ordered, dependency-aware tasks with acceptance criteria, but produces planning documents rather than the requested tracker issues and feature-or-maintenance classification.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Feature-or-maintenance classification and one issue for each delivery phase with plan-step references.
assessments.rationale: It publishes dependency-aware issues with acceptance criteria, but its tracer-bullet slices are not constrained to delivery phases and it uses HITL/AFK rather than the requested work classification.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Creating actionable tracker issues from an implementation plan.
assessments.rationale: This skill performs GO and KEGG enrichment and plotting, which has no plausible planning-to-tracker-issues route.

assessments.missing_material_requirement_or_null: Explicit dependency preservation, acceptance checks, and references to the relevant plan step.
assessments.rationale: It creates one labelled issue per implementation-plan phase, but its specified issue content does not require the requested dependencies, acceptance checks, or plan-step references.
